currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.40 product code is merged, deployed, and live-verified. The only remaining FINAL.40 evidence is the operator's real iPhone retest of the fullscreen-start timeout and long-route highway/JCT behavior.
releaseScope: Fullscreen route start no longer re-clicks the already-active MAP tab, avoiding a redundant full map render while the route request is in flight.

Fullscreen viewport settle may invalidate Leaflet size but skips route redraw/refit while route acquisition is busy; the 20s client timer is cleared after the response body is received before local route processing.

The existing maximum-two via-IC budget samples one balanced pair plus one geographically distinct bounded corridor when available, allowing ORS driving-hgv to traverse farther JCT-connected motorway networks.
Long-route motorway discovery target may scale to 80km; FINAL.36 final detour caps and all exact HGV restrictions remain authoritative.
